The PNG `official-logo.png` preserves the existing official SKUAS logo bytes used by prior Renewal Letter local review artifacts. It is a branding regression fixture, not a replacement logo.

`photo.png` and `signature.png` are visibly labeled synthetic QA images. They represent no actual site, pest activity, treatment or real signature. Never import these fixtures into production.

All customer, job, contract, company-address, Non-GST identity and treatment details in the fixture code are synthetic. Example email addresses use the reserved `.invalid` domain. No production credentials or customer records are required.
